stem:
Benzoic acid, $\text{C}_6\text{H}_5\text{COOH}$, is a weak acid. The $K_{\text{a}}$ of benzoic acid is $6.31 \times 10^{-5} \text{ mol dm}^{-3}$ at $298 \text{ K}$.

A $1.00 \text{ dm}^3$ buffer solution is made at $298 \text{ K}$ containing $1.00 \text{ g}$ of $\text{C}_6\text{H}_5\text{COOH}$ and a slightly greater mass of sodium benzoate, $\text{C}_6\text{H}_5\text{COO}^-\text{Na}^+$.

This buffer solution has a pH of 4.15.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.stem: Write equations to show how this solution acts as a buffer solution when the named substances are added to it:

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Calculate the $\text{H}^+$ concentration and the $\text{C}_6\text{H}_5\text{COOH}$ concentration in the buffer solution described. Use the expression for the $K_{\text{a}}$ of $\text{C}_6\text{H}_5\text{COOH}$ to calculate the concentration of $\text{C}_6\text{H}_5\text{COO}^-\text{Na}^+$ in the buffer solution.

Show your working and give each answer to a minimum of **three** significant figures.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
A $10.0 \text{ cm}^3$ sample of the buffer solution is mixed with $10.0 \text{ cm}^3$ of $1.00 \text{ mol dm}^{-3}$ $\text{KOH}$. Both solutions are at $298 \text{ K}$. A reaction is allowed to occur without stirring.

Two observations are recorded:

- the temperature, after the reaction is complete, is fractionally above $298 \text{ K}$
- the pH, after the reaction, is greater than 13.

Explain these two observations.

parts.label: (e)(i)
parts.stem:
Magnesium benzoate, $\text{Mg}(\text{C}_6\text{H}_5\text{COO})_2$, has a solubility in water of less than $1.00 \text{ g dm}^{-3}$ at $298 \text{ K}$.

$$K_{\text{sp}} = [\text{Mg}^{2+}][\text{C}_6\text{H}_5\text{COO}^-]^2 = 1.76 \times 10^{-7} \text{ at } 298 \text{ K}$$
parts.text:
Calculate the solubility of $\text{Mg}(\text{C}_6\text{H}_5\text{COO})_2$ in water at $298 \text{ K}$. Give your answer in $\text{g dm}^{-3}$.

Show your working.

[$M_{\text{r}}$: $\text{Mg}(\text{C}_6\text{H}_5\text{COO})_2$, 266.3]

parts.label: (e)(ii)
parts.text:
An excess of $\text{Mg}(\text{C}_6\text{H}_5\text{COO})_2$ is added to a sample of $0.50 \text{ mol dm}^{-3}$ $\text{MgSO}_4$ at $298 \text{ K}$.

State whether the equilibrium concentration of $\text{Mg}(\text{C}_6\text{H}_5\text{COO})_2$ is higher than, the same as, or lower than your answer to (i). Explain your answer.
